msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia de-flores-y-floreros-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a pair of mustard yellow leather pointed flat shoes with blue gingham bows, and a pair of pale blue pointed flats from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia de-flores-y-floreros-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of a pointed flat shoe in a colourful floral print fabric with a small strap (flat lay) from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia de-flores-y-floreros-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing purple velvet pointed flats with a big pink bow, worn with wide beige trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#EEE9E2) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia de-flores-y-floreros-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of olive green leather ankle boots with mustard studded details from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia de-flores-y-floreros-14.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of grey suede pointed ankle boots with long fringes and a kitten heel from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail.
